preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have been authorized by the owner

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the setBotBlacklist() function with the target contract address and set the flag to true. This will blacklist the contract, preventing it from making transactions. The vulnerability allows the owner to arbitrarily block any contract from interacting with the token.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The OptiFi contract has a setBotBlacklist() function that can only be called by the owner. This allows the owner to arbitrarily blacklist any address, preventing it from making transactions. The vulnerability is that the owner can abuse this privilege to block any contract from interacting with the token.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setBotBlacklist() to blacklist the target contract address.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Get the owner address from the contract
2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner
3. Call setBotBlacklist(targetAddress, true)
4. Verify the target is now blacklisted
